First public release of Teams Listener: record meetings on Windows and transcribe them **offline**. No bot joins the call, and nothing is uploaded.

## Highlights
- **Records both sides:** everything your PC plays ("Others") plus your mic ("Me"). The mic starts muted, and you unmute it with **Ctrl+Alt+M** or the big button only when you speak.
- **Works with Bluetooth headphones.** Devices can connect or disconnect mid-meeting without losing audio.
- **Floating pill:** stays on top of your call with the timer and mute state. It appears whenever you leave the window while recording.
- **Offline transcription** with faster-whisper (`small.en` by default, `medium.en` optional), with timestamps and speaker labels.
- **Meetings library:** search across all transcripts, read them in the app, play the audio, and view only your own lines.
- **Crash-safe:** audio is written continuously, so a crash keeps what was recorded and you can transcribe it later.
- Windows 11 look, light/dark theme, and a tray icon.

## Install

Download **`Teams Listener Setup 1.0.0.exe`** below and run it. It installs for your user only (no admin rights).

> The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC".
> Click **More info → Run anyway**. You can check the download against `SHA256SUMS.txt`
> (`Get-FileHash .\"Teams Listener Setup 1.0.0.exe"` in PowerShell).

The first transcription downloads the speech model once (`small.en`, about 480 MB).

**Requirements:** Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, and no GPU.

This installer was built by the [Release workflow](https://github.com/nithishtrystuffs/teams-listener/actions/workflows/release.yml) from the tagged source.

> Recording other people may require their consent. Check the law and your employer's policy.
